items.title: Theodore Purnell Interview, 1972-06-16
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Alvin Wall? You know Fats. Alvin Wall? [INTERVIEWEE] Yeah.

ctx.x: That's the guy you talk about? I know. Him and Dave just play the guy. Oh, I see. Oh.
The Pichon used to come low by it. Is Alvin Wall in that Navy picture? Who?
Alvin Wall? You know Fats. Alvin Wall?
